name: NEXTDC P2 Perth (East Perth / Perth CBD)
notes: Re-verified: NEXTDC P2 at 11 Newcastle Street, East Perth (Perth CBD) is operational, 20MW+ IT load, Australia/WA's first Uptime Tier IV certified data centre (design and constructed); opened July 2020, 12,000 sqm technical space.

name: Equinix PE1 Perth (East Perth, formerly Metronode Perth 1)
notes: Re-verified with corrected LGA: Equinix PE1 is at 3 Tully Road, East Perth (City of Perth LGA), inherited from the Metronode acquisition; operating colocation/IBX facility, ~7,113 sqft with 4,811 sqft raised floor. No public MW capacity.

name: DCW (DC West) Pier Street data centre
notes: Directory-listed legacy colocation facility at L1/234 Pier Street, Perth CBD (City of Perth LGA). Weak secondary evidence only; capacity and current operating details unverified.

name: NEXTDC PH1 Port Hedland
notes: Re-verified: NEXTDC PH1 at 17 Loreto Circuit, Port Hedland is an operational Tier III certified edge data centre (first in the Pilbara), part of a 3-module portable build serving mining/resources workloads; ~1.5MW capacity (some listings cite 1MW). No other datacentre projects found in the Town of Port Hedland.

name: Vocus DC-PER05 Osborne Park data centre
notes: Re-verified: Vocus operates a Perth metro colocation facility at Osborne Park (43 King Edward Road per directories), formerly the ASG/Amcom Perth facility acquired by Vocus in Aug 2014 (A$11.7m); Vocus colocation brochure labels it DC-PER05. No public MW capacity.

name: DC Two Osborne Park micro data centre
notes: Re-verified lead: DC Two operates a regional/edge network including a ~200kW micro data centre in Osborne Park (City of Stirling), identified in trade coverage around the company's public listing. Small edge facility.

name: GlobalEdge / Data Centre Limited Balcatta data centre
notes: Re-verified lead: facility directories and PeeringDB identify a carrier-neutral data centre at 247 Balcatta Road, Balcatta (City of Stirling). Primary/current operator detail limited; capacity and operating status unverified.

name: Equinix PE2 Perth (Shenton Park, formerly Metronode)
notes: Re-verified: Equinix PE2 at 37 Lemnos Street, Shenton Park (City of Subiaco LGA), inherited from Metronode; operates as Shenton Park cable landing station and colocation IBX. No public MW capacity.

name: Equinix PE3 Perth (Shenton Park)
notes: Re-verified: Equinix PE3, third Perth IBX at 37 Lemnos Street, Shenton Park (City of Subiaco LGA), launched December 2020 and completed 2022 (InsightPS D&C). Operational; no public MW capacity.

name: NEXTDC P1 Perth (Malaga) + Stage 2 expansion
notes: Re-verified: NEXTDC P1 at 4 Millrose Drive, Malaga (City of Swan LGA) is operational (Tier III, 6MW); Stage 2 by Multiplex doubles long-term IT capacity from 6MW to 12MW with a new 1,069 sqm data hall, targeted for completion in 2026.

name: Fujitsu Malaga data centre
notes: Re-verified lead: Fujitsu advertises Australian data centre services and facility directories/PeeringDB place the facility at 16 Mulgul Road, Malaga (City of Swan LGA). Official page is service-generic; location via directories, so graded B. No public MW.

name: HostAway Malaga data centre
notes: Re-verified lead: HostAway states it operates Perth data centre services from its Malaga facility (8 Midas Road, City of Swan LGA per directories/PeeringDB). No public MW capacity.

name: GreenSquareDC Hazelmere 120MW data centre campus (withdrawn)
notes: Re-verified with updated status: GreenSquareDC's proposed up-to-120MW / ~$1.1bn data centre in Hazelmere (Stirling Crescent area, City of Swan LGA) had its development application withdrawn on 13 March 2026 after ~1,900 public submissions; the WA DAP assessment panel had been recommended to refuse (May 2026). Coded rejected: project did not proceed under GreenSquareDC.
